dict.string: Lumen asks Finder to move files you choose to the Trash, so you can restore them later with Put Back.
Lumen indexes your Desktop so you can find files there. The index stays on this Mac.
Lumen indexes your Documents folder so you can find files there. The index stays on this Mac.
Lumen indexes your Downloads folder so you can find files there. The index stays on this Mac.
Lumen indexes external drives you connect so you can find their files, even while they are unplugged. The index stays on this Mac.
Lumen indexes network drives you connect so you can find their files. The index stays on this Mac.
